tasks.objective: Create the file docs/early.md and no other file: line 1 exactly "# Early", line 2 exactly "Status: done". Do not call any coordination tool. Then stop.

FIRST, send one message to the peer task whose key is "early", using the coordinator's own tool: the MCP tool named send_message provided by the MCP server named "workforce". Do NOT use your runtime's built-in agent-collaboration send_message tool; that one addresses your runtime's own sub-agents, it is not the coordinator, and it will tell you the agent id is not found. Address the workforce tool with `to` set to that peer's task id, subject "Late question", body text "Please confirm your status.". SECOND, do not wait for a reply and do not retry more than once. THIRD, create the file docs/late.md and no other file: line 1 exactly "# Late", line 2 exactly "Send result: <RESULT>" where <RESULT> is one line reporting what the workforce coordinator told you about that call, quoting its error code verbatim if it refused. Then stop.
